hero.title: Our Mission
hero.description: Mobilizing large scale recurring funding to protect forests and oceans while helping reduce climate and biodiversity risks.
hero.titleExt: Born in the most biodiverse country on Earth.
hero.descriptionExt: Built to fix what commerce broke. Colombia holds approximately 10% of all species on the planet and it is also losing forests to economic forces that conservation funding has never matched.

vision.title: Nature and climate action at no cost
vision.body: Sustainable Discounts™ redirects hidden costs in commerce so that climate and biodiversity action can scale without extra user spending.

originSection.headline: The question he couldn't stop asking.
originSection.body1: After running multi-billion dollar consumer electronics businesses, our founder watched billions disappear into distribution infrastructure, and ignoring the planet.
originSection.body2: He kept asking: what if that money could work harder? The answer was always nature.
originSection.quote: We are not solving a hypothetical problem. We are from Colombia, the most biodiverse country on Earth per square kilometer. This is personal.
originSection.author: Damian Estrada, Founder and CEO

problemSection.headline: Nature doesn't have a solutions problem. It has a funding problem.
problemSection.body1: The projects are planned. The scientists are trained. The rangers are ready.
problemSection.body2: What's missing is the money: recurring, reliable, and not dependent on political calendars.

insightSection.headline: The money is there. It just wasn't going anywhere useful.
insightSection.body1: Every durable goods purchase includes a hidden cost.
insightSection.body2: It goes to marketplace infrastructure. Not the product. Not the planet.
insightSection.body3: SD doesn't ask for new money. It asks commerce to be transparent about money that was always there.

solutionSection.headline: A pricing mechanism, not a charity.

solutionSection.footer: Not from generosity but from adding transparency to commerce.

visionSection.headline: What the world looks like if this works.

hero.title: How It Works
hero.description: Merchants use existing discounts and Sustainable Discounts™ turns them into Sustainable Discounts™ connected to verified environmental outcomes.
hero.descriptionExt: SD converts a portion of the fees you surrender to marketplace infrastructure into a discount for shoppers, a conservation contribution, and recovered margin for your brand. No additional cost. No donation budget required.

steps.title: Merchants use existing discounts
steps.body: Sustainable Discounts™ converts any existing discount into a Sustainable Discount flow without disrupting the current commerce setup.

steps.title: Choose eligible products
steps.body: Merchants define which products show the contribution option so shoppers can choose in product detail pages.

steps.title: Shoppers choose discount or contribution
steps.body: Customers choose between more discount or more contribution, creating measurable impact directly from purchase decisions.

steps.title: Checkout stays the same
steps.body: Cart and checkout continue normally while contributions are routed to certified projects and tracked over time.

problemSection.title: For every $1,000 in revenue.
problemSection.body1: Up to $400 goes to marketplace fees. The shopper doesn't know the split. And most marketplace agreements include a price parity clause.
problemSection.body2: You cannot offer the same product for less on your own store. So you earn less on the marketplace, and you can't compete on your own channel.
problemSection.body3: That is the secret. SD makes it visible.

mechanismSection.headline: Here is what changes when SD is live on your store.
mechanismSection.withItem2: Your revenue: $900 ($300 more than through the marketplace)
mechanismSection.withItem3: Nature receives: at least $30, up to $100 via the slider
mechanismSection.withItem4: SD operational fee: 10% of the conservation contribution: at least $3, up to $10 via slider.
mechanismSection.body: You set the pool. SD guarantees 30% minimum goes to conservation. The rest is the shopper discount. The shopper uses the slider to decide: keep more discount, or give more to the planet. You always receive $900. Your revenue is fixed. The shopper carries the only variable.
mechanismSection.quote: The first funding mechanism where everyone wins by design.

featureSection.title: What SD looks like for your brand, in practice.
featureSection.item1Title: A banner at the product page.
featureSection.item1Body: "Shop now and we give you and the planet up to $X on this item." A financial announcement, not a donation popup.
featureSection.item2Body: Square meters of habitat protected, species supported, CO2 avoided. Calculated in real time.
featureSection.item3Body: The shopper splits the pool. You are not involved. Your margin is fixed.
featureSection.item4Title: A sustainability landing page for your brand.
featureSection.item4Body: Your cumulative impact, updated in real time. SD provides the marketing assets.
featureSection.item5Body: Conservation certificates, biodiversity credit records, or consolidated reports. SD handles everything.
featureSection.item6Body: Eco-conscious shoppers accumulate cross-brand conservation histories. Your brand is part of that network.

sdgsSection.title: The Eight UN SDGs
sdgsSection.desc: Not a marketing claim. The result of decades of research on what keeping a forest standing actually does.
sdgsSection.sdg1Body: 1.2 billion people depend directly on forests for their livelihoods. When a forest goes, their economic base goes with it.
sdgsSection.sdg2Body: The Amazon generates the flying rivers that carry rainfall for hundreds of millions of people. Deforestation breaks that cycle.
sdgsSection.sdg3Body: Intact forests reduce the risk of zoonotic disease spillover. The science connecting deforestation to pandemic risk is well established.
sdgsSection.sdg6Body: Forests are the most effective water filtration systems on Earth. When they go, rivers run brown and water costs rise.
sdgsSection.sdg8Body: Conservation projects funded by SD create employment in the most economically vulnerable regions: rangers, scientists, community monitors.
sdgsSection.sdg13Body: Forest protection delivers over 30% of the emission reductions needed by 2030. Every intact hectare is a carbon vault.
sdgsSection.sdg14Body: Reduced deforestation means less sediment runoff, protecting the reef and seagrass ecosystems that 3 billion people depend on for food.
sdgsSection.sdg15Body: Forest protection preserves biodiversity and supports indigenous communities, the most effective long-term stewards of their territories.
